metadata.title: Flexibx — AI Marketing Manager
metadata.description: An AI marketing manager that works 24/7: it understands your brand, plans your content, analyzes your results and recommends what to do next.

home.title: An AI marketing manager that works for you 24/7
home.subtitle: Flexibx builds a lasting understanding of your brand, turns it into content plans and campaigns, then learns from the results to make your next marketing better.
home.loopTitle: A marketing loop that keeps improving

brand.title: Understand your brand
brand.description: The Brand Brain remembers your identity, audience and tone of voice, so you never explain your business twice.

plan.title: Plan and create content
plan.description: 30-day content plans, posts and ads in Arabic and English, ready for review and approval.

publish.title: Schedule and publish
publish.description: A unified calendar that publishes at the right time to your social accounts.

improve.title: Analyze and improve
improve.description: Clear recommendations: what happened, why it happened and what to do next, executable in one click.

home.principle: We measure success by better marketing results, not by how much content is generated.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: Sorry about that. The problem has been logged, and you can try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page may have moved, or the link is incorrect.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to manage your workspaces.
signIn.registered: Thanks. If this is a new account, we've sent a verification link to your email address. Verify it, then sign in.
signIn.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.verified: Your email address is verified. You can sign in now.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Create your Flexibx account, then sign in to set up your workspace.
signUp.name: Full name

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalidInput: Some of the information is invalid. Please review the highlighted fields.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't complete this request. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.emailNotVerified: Please verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox, or send a new verification link.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.description: Open the link we emailed you to confirm your address. Links expire after one hour and work once.
verifyEmail.confirmDescription: Select the button below to finish verifying your email address.
verifyEmail.invalid: This verification link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
verifyEmail.alreadyVerified: Your email address is already verified.
verifyEmail.resendDescription: Enter your email address. If an unverified account uses it, we'll send a new verification link.
verifyEmail.resendSent: If an unverified account uses this email address, we've sent a new verification link. Check your inbox.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your account's email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account uses this email address, we've sent a link to reset the password. It expires in one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: After you change it, every device signed in to your account is signed out.
resetPassword.invalid: This reset link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
resetPassword.missing: Open the reset link from your email to choose a new password.

changePassword.title: Account security
changePassword.description: Change your password. Every other device signed in to your account will be signed out.
changePassword.success: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.

list.title: Your workspaces
list.description: Choose the workspace you want to open.

new.title: Create a workspace
new.description: A workspace holds your brand, content and team. You will be its owner.
new.name: Workspace name
new.slugHint: 3–48 characters: lowercase English letters, digits and hyphens. It appears in your workspace link.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can open this workspace and what they can do.
members.forbidden: Your role doesn't include viewing the member list.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: Invitations expire after 7 days and can be used once, only by the invited email address.
invite.notSentDevelopment: No email was sent: email delivery is not configured in this environment (development).
invite.notSentNotConfigured: No email was sent: no email provider is configured.
invite.notSentFailed: No email was sent: the email could not be delivered.
invite.shareLink: Copy this link and share it with the invitee yourself. It is shown only once.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.revokeConfirm: Revoke the invitation for {email}? The link will stop working.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.description: You will lose access to this workspace until someone invites you again.
leave.lastOwner: You are the only owner, so you can't leave this workspace.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.validNoInviter: You were invited to join {workspace} as {role}.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invite.mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.
invite.alreadyMember: You already belong to this workspace.

invitation.subject: You're invited to join {workspace} on Flexibx
invitation.intro: {inviter} invited you to join the workspace {workspace} on Flexibx as {role}.
invitation.expiry: This invitation expires on {date} and can be used once.
invitation.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

verification.subject: Verify your email address for Flexibx
verification.intro: Hello {name}, confirm that this is your email address to finish setting up your Flexibx account.
verification.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once.
verification.ignore: If you didn't create a Flexibx account, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Flexibx password
passwordReset.intro: Hello {name}, we received a request to reset the password for your Flexibx account.
passwordReset.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can be used once. After the reset, every device signed in to your account is signed out.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.
